title: instance.background_intent.changed payload (v1)
description: Payload of the instance.background_intent.changed outbox event (MVR-06B, #3864, docs/MULTI_VAULT_RUNTIME/BIND_BACKGROUND_LIFECYCLES.md). Producer: app.instance.background_supervisor.emit_background_intent_event, called after the durable registry generation of the compatibility bridge handoff, a post-handoff compatibility picker/default rebind, a governed background-intent add/remove, or the MVR-06 channel-transfer repair hook. Idempotency key basis: (topic, intent_revision, 'instance-background-intent-changed-v1'). Lineage posture: an idempotent wake-up hint only; the background supervisor reconciles the durable registry revision and auth epoch, so a lost or duplicated hint never changes truth. Redaction: binding identity and revisions only, never a content-root path, vault name, filesystem identity, or other raw binding payload.

intent_revision.description: The durable background-intent revision this hint announces.

registry_revision.description: The registry generation that committed the revision.

vault_binding_ids.description: The bindings the supervisor runs: empty for explicit-empty or compatibility no-vault; at most one in MVR-06B.
